relevant_laws.quote: If the driver of a vehicle intends to turn at an intersection and: The turn is a left turn from a two-directional highway onto a one-way highway, the approach for the left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof, and the turn must be made by turning from the right of the centerline where it enters the intersection as close as practicable to the left-hand curb of the one-way highway.
relevant_laws.notes: The frozen intersection/left-turn/centerline cell matches the express turn branch; physical roadway facts remain to verify.
